Delicious Seafood
Mar 2026 • Solo
I came to this place after reading its positive reviews, and it definitely lived up to expectations. It’s conveniently located not far from Back Beach, 700–800 meters from Ibis Hotel, making it an easy walk.

I ordered the grilled prawns and pomfret fish hotpot, and both dishes were delicious. The grilled prawns, especially with the green paste, were outstanding—full of flavor and very fresh. The hotpot was also satisfying, with a rich and comforting taste.

The staff hospitality was great as well. They were friendly, attentive, and made the dining experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, I highly recommend this place for anyone staying in Vung Tau who is looking for fresh and tasty seafood in a convenient location.

Highly recommended for those who love fresh fish
Mar 2026 • Couples
I have been to this seafood restaurant and I must say that the experience was really very pleasant. We started with garlic prawns, very tasty and well cooked. The scent of garlic enhanced the taste of the fish without covering it, a sign that the ingredients were fresh and quality. Then we tried the shrimp skewers rolled in bacon, a really good match: the shrimps were tender and juicy and the bacon added that crispy and tasty note that makes the dish even more interesting. A special mention goes also to the desserts, really super. Overall a great experience .Recommended to those who love fish and want to try well-kept and well-balanced flavors.
